records.text: An anonymous woodworker told the show that black nitrile gloves are the most resistant gloves for handling cyanoacrylate glue and spray activator.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: He said. Hey guys, just an FYI, I do woodworking as a hobby and I use CA glue and spray activator and I'm not sure where I learned it, but I always remember being told to use black nitrile gloves because it's the most resistant to that crazy adhesive.

verification.notes: Reviewed the actual anonymous tip and Owens's stronger confirmation in context. A Henkel manufacturer SDS supports nitrile gloves for its specified cyanoacrylate product. It does not establish that black gloves are the most resistant, that color confers easier adhesive removal, or compatibility with every spray activator. Those stronger claims remain unsupported by the reviewed primary material. No source identifies the photographed object, the microphone adhesive, residue, or any cleanup. This is limited product-specific support, not a general protective-equipment recommendation.

sources.title: Cyamet Rapid Adhesive (Superglue) Safety Data Sheet
sources.relevance: The safety data sheet specifies nitrile-rubber gloves for cyanoacrylate handling and gives a breakthrough time, but makes no color distinction.

sources.title: Are Black Nitrile Gloves Stronger Than Blue?
sources.relevance: Explains that equal-thickness black and blue nitrile use the same base material and that dye does not confer added chemical resistance.

sources.title: Henkel LOCTITE 4861 Safety Data Sheet, section 8
sources.relevance: Manufacturer guidance specifies nitrile protection for this particular cyanoacrylate product. It supplies no black-color superiority, all-activator comparison, or microphone-residue evidence.

records.text: The anonymous woodworker suggested, as a hypothetical use for the gloves, quickly cleaning adhesive-covered broken pieces from a RØDE microphone.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep 1CFDtD0IgEg)

appearances.snippet: For example, if you were trying to clean off all the broken pieces of glass from a road microphone that has adhesive on it in a hurry.
